title: Avila Core State Transition v0.1 draft
description: ADR-0021: one immutable record per state move, appended to the campaign JSONL log under the same lock as attempts. The `from_state` must equal the subject's derived state when the line lands; the `(from, to)` pair must be legal under the subject kind's closed table; the named attestation must be signed under the role the transition class requires.

identity.description: The subject's bound identity — the contract `id@rev`, the campaign id, or `campaign/step` for a step.

from_state.description: The state the subject's recorded history derives; must be legal under the subject kind's table.

sha256.description: The exact attestation record digest the transition cites.

at.description: The recorded instant the actor states the move happened at.

step_effects.description: Per-step effects the transition records — an amendment-driven campaign supersession names the in-flight steps it cancels here.
